# nullplatform_dimensions (Data Source)

Lists the dimensions visible at an NRN: those defined at it and at its ancestors. An application's NRN also lists the dimensions defined at its account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nullplatform = {
      source = "nullplatform/nullplatform"
    }
  }
}

provider "nullplatform" {}

# The dimensions visible at an account, with their values
data "nullplatform_dimensions" "account" {
  nrn = "organization=1234567890:account=987654321"
}

output "environments" {
  value = flatten([
    for dimension in data.nullplatform_dimensions.account.dimensions :
    [for value in dimension.values : value.slug] if dimension.slug == "environment"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nrn` (String) The NRN to list dimensions at, e.g. `organization=1:account=2`.

### Read-Only

- `dimensions` (List of Object) The dimensions visible at the NRN, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dimensions))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
